en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, both together from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying regarding a man who killed a woman deliberately. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If her family so desire to they can kill him, and pay half the wergild to his family; and if they so desire, they can take half the wergild of five thousand Dirhams’.

And he<sup>asws</sup> said regarding a woman who killed her husband deliberately, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If his family so desire to, they can killer her for his killing, and no one reaps more than the crime upon himself’.
